component.summary: Your own library of e-books and articles
Своя библиотека электронных книг и статей

description.p: Build, read and organize your own library: folders on disk with books and articles (EPUB, FB2, MOBI, PDF), each with its own graph and backups, browsed together as one big library. LitRes is a pluggable library of purchased books and audiobooks.

Создавайте, читайте и организуйте свою библиотеку: папки с книгами и статьями (EPUB, FB2, MOBI, PDF), у каждой свой граф и резервные копии, все вместе — одна большая библиотека. ЛитРес — подключаемая библиотека купленных книг и аудиокниг.
A Focus page with the mastery map: topics you know by level, where to look next and one-click focus from any topic; wiki page fixes; internal refactoring.

The book graph includes your Obsidian wiki, possible tags and an analysis; a daily review of your quotes and a random passage; a reading focus with next-book suggestions; touch scrolling on the main screen.
Highlights and notes with four meaning colors, also in PDF; export to an Obsidian vault (LLM Wiki layout) with links back to the quote; reading status and tags in the wiki.
Internal refactoring; the reader's font size label follows the pinch gesture.
